description: Browse World Bank indicators by theme. With no topic_id, lists all 21 topics (Agriculture, Health, Climate Change, Education, etc.). With a topic_id, lists every indicator under that topic — the best way to discover indicators for a subject without keyword guessing.

topic_id.description: Topic ID to list its indicators (e.g. '8' = Health). Omit to list all topics.

name: wb_topics
